input.quote: MSL will provide replacement value insurance coverage for consigned Products. IBM will be named as a joint insured with respect to consigned Products for its interest.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no general vendor insurance article. The only insurance obligations are asset-specific: replacement-value cover on consigned Products with IBM as joint insured (§13.1, p0909) and joint insured status on IBM-owned tooling (§21.2, p1107); other references are to freight/shipment insurance costs. There is no commercial general liability, errors and omissions, cyber/privacy, or workers' compensation cover, and no certificate right. MSL performs at leased IBM premises, handles IBM inventory and holds access to IBM I/T systems and data, so the absence of cover falls into walk-away territory and fails both the preferred and fallback checklists. We insert a short insurance clause as new §16.22 at the end of the General article at the preferred thresholds, with the fallback (E&O USD 1,000,000 / cyber USD 2,000,000) offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert a vendor insurance clause (16.22) in the General article
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no general insurance article for MSL, which performs on our premises and accesses our systems and data; we have added a short standard insurance clause at 16.22 (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M where MSL processes our data, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). If helpful, we can fall back to E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: Insurance. MSL shall maintain throughout the term of this Agreement: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where MSL processes any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for IBM, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. MSL shall provide certificates of insurance to IBM on request.

Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
